newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia congratulates Clinton on victory.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia congratulates Clinton on victory.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad on Thursday congratulated Bill Clinton on his election victory and said he looked forward to consultations with the president to promote world security.

Mahathir, who is visiting Guinea in west Africa, said he "valued the consultations and other efforts that had been taken to strengthen Malaysia-U.S. bilateral relations", a Foreign Ministry statement said.
"I look forward to continue working with you in the promotion of world peace and security, especially in Bosnia-Herzegovina," Mahathir said.
Mahathir and Clinton have met several times over the past three years.
